question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL OR i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0 THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    ELSE 'Multi item line'
  END AS order_item_line_group,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
  SUM(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS total_ordered_quantity,
  AVG(i.ITEM_QUANTITY) AS avg_ordered_quantity_per_order
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 
  CASE order_item_line_group 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0 
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1 
    ELSE 2 
  END;

action.reason: To calculate the share of each group (one item line, multi item line, and orders with no item line), I need the total number of orders in 2025. The previous query only included orders with at least one item line.

action.query:
SELECT COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS no_item_line_orders
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
  AND (i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL OR i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 0);
action.reason: To report the number of orders with no item line separately, I need to count orders where the item line count is null or zero. This will complete the population breakdown for all requested groups.

action.answer: In 2025, all 4,359,773 recorded orders contained at least one item line; there were no orders with zero item lines. Of these, 1,307,684 orders (30.0%) had exactly one item line, and 3,052,089 orders (70.0%) had more than one item line. The average ordered units per order was 1.219753 for one-line orders and 3.484769 for multi-line orders. Units are item units per order. Interpretation: Multi-line orders are the majority and have a much higher average quantity per order than single-line orders. No orders lacked item lines in this period.
